name: Toby Williams
bio: Toby Williams is a British actor, writer and award-winning stand-up comedian performing both as himself and Dr George Ryegold.

credits.title: The Intimacy Coordinator
credits.overview: Kate is an intimacy coordinator. She is also a sex addict.

credits.title: Pressure
credits.overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

credits.title: Tiny Little Voices
credits.overview: Anna hasn't left her apartment since the pandemic. She's delighted in there, especially because she goes on great adventures with her imaginary friend Walter. credits.title: Hostages
credits.overview: After a terrifying London hotel explosion, three strangers hide together in a room, navigating a chaotic hostage situation that satirizes the 24-hour news cycle, self-proclaimed experts, and society’s obsession with social media over human life.

credits.title: JOY
credits.overview: A young nurse, a visionary scientist and an innovative surgeon face opposition from the church, state, media and medical establishment, in their pursuit of the world’s first ‘test tube baby’, Louise Joy Brown.

credits.title: Wet Fish
credits.overview: Have you ever heard the expression "would you like a slap in the belly with a wet fish?"  This film would probably make more sense if you had. Or maybe not...

credits.title: Borrowed Time
credits.overview: Thanks to new technology, Liam is able to bring his dead Dad back to life for just five minutes and finally ask a very important question.

credits.title: Bleep
credits.overview: A couple’s relationship is pushed to the brink as they investigate a strange noise that’s woken them up. This is a story about a bickering couple and a mysterious noise that punctuates their argument.

credits.title: The Drowning of Arthur Braxton
credits.overview: When an awkward, heavily bullied schoolboy from a dysfunctional home discovers a beautiful water nymph hiding in an abandoned Edwardian bathhouse, he must confront his own personal demons in order to save them both from the depraved custodian who keeps the enchanted waters alive with the ritual sacrifice of children.

credits.title: Don’t Walk
credits.overview: Jon and Val like to take a nice stroll, but they might want to quicken their pace if they want to stay alive.

credits.title: Elderflower
credits.overview: Emily has opened a florist, she's living her dream, but she soon learns her new venture used to be a front for an entirely different business altogether.

credits.title: There Are No Dividends
credits.overview: Darren Hobbs, an entrepreneur, sneaks into a hotel conference room to conduct a careers day. credits.title: The Current War
credits.overview: Electricity titans Thomas Edison and George Westinghouse compete to create a sustainable system and market it to the American people.

credits.title: High-Rise
credits.overview: Life for the residents of a tower block begins to run out of control.

credits.title: Milk!
credits.overview: Timothy and Raymond have run out of milk

credits.title: Paddington
credits.overview: A young Peruvian bear travels to London in search of a home. Finding himself lost and alone at Paddington Station, he meets the kindly Brown family, who offer him a temporary haven.

credits.title: Saving Santa
credits.overview: A lowly stable elf finds that he is the only one who can stop an invasion of the North Pole by using the secret of Santa's Sleigh, a TimeGlobe, to travel back in time to Save Santa - twice.

credits.title: Battlecock!
credits.overview: The Dukinson brothers have finally beaten their arch rivals, but the Krullmuller sisters are out for blood and revenge is a dish best served underarm.

credits.title: Island Queen
credits.overview: Mim has never ventured off her little hometown island. It's time to leap into the adult world, by getting pregnant, with deeply unpleasant consequences.
